title: BCD Converter
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Clocks and Watches with AI
description: Two rows of bit lights compare ordinary binary with BCD for 0 to 59, with a hex byte decoder, the read-as-integer mistake, and a Predict mode.

learningObjectives: Apply BCD encoding and decoding with shifts and masks
Compare BCD with ordinary binary for the same number

keyQuestions: Why does the BCD byte look like the decimal number in hex?
What happens if you read a BCD byte as an ordinary integer?
commonMisconceptions: 0x45 means 69 seconds in an RTC register
BCD and binary are the same for every number
assessmentOpportunities: Decode a seconds register that reads 0x52

controls: Read BCD byte as integer checkbox
